$comment: THE ONE REGISTRY for the instrument lab's knobs (ADR-154). Read by /test/instrument-lab (TS import through lib/instrument/variants.ts) and by scripts/capture-instrument.mjs (readFileSync). TYPE IDS ARE LETTERS ONLY. THE FIRST VALUE OF EVERY KNOB IS THE HOUSE: IA is every knob at its first value and the control; every other direction is one argument against it. The `zoom` knob is the owner's 'try all': three engines for the altitude transition, decided on the read, the losers deleted with their guards (ADR-070 U35).

housing.label: Housing
housing.note: lip = the housing's one sanctioned gold line, lit on the altitude you are at. seam = every frame in dawn; gold spent on the chip and the lit plates alone.

panel.label: Panel
panel.note: strip = Tensor Lake's header band inside the frame: label left, state chip right. bare = the label alone over a hairline.

ribbon.label: Ribbon
ribbon.note: eight = R4's eight-wire ribbon at pitch 4, the switchboard's bundle. four = half the conductors, the same pitch.

ground.label: Ground
ground.note: dots = the 24px dot grid under the wiring, masked to the centre. void = the page alone.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.note: css = data-altitude swaps and CSS transitions: a cut with a fade, no layout interpolation. flip = gsap/Flip moves the same six nodes between their seats. anime = animejs timelines do the same; the lab's dependency only.

directions.name: House
directions.question: does one record, drawn at five altitudes with the house values, read as one instrument the reader can zoom?
directions.shape: the TR+BL housing on a gold lip, Tensor Lake's strip, eight wires, the dot grid, a cut between altitudes

directions.name: Dawn
directions.question: with the housing in dawn, is the one lit object enough to say where you are?
directions.shape: the same five altitudes with no gold on any frame

directions.name: Bare
directions.question: without the header strip, does a panel still read as a module of the same device?
directions.shape: the same five altitudes, every panel headed by its label alone

directions.name: Four
directions.question: do four conductors still read as wiring, or do they read as lines?
directions.shape: the work altitude at half the ribbon

directions.name: Void
directions.question: without the dot grid, does the wiring float?
directions.shape: the work altitude on the page alone

directions.name: Flip
directions.question: when the same six nodes travel between their seats, does the reader keep hold of the object across the zoom?

directions.name: Anime
directions.question: does animejs's timeline give the explainer feel the owner named, and what does it cost against Flip?

wave.note: 1280x720 is the binding cell; 1470x830 is the owner's laptop; 1920x1247 the owner's window. The jury scores the surfaces board per cell.
